correctness.rationale: Every shortest path can be reduced to a face-simple walk. The 80 exact developed candidates, grouped into 24 quadratic coefficient classes, satisfy exhaustive affine lower bounds on two triangles; explicit feasible two-face paths attain the bound. Analytic area integration gives the CDF and exact moments. Endpoint asymptotic checked by rescaling; standalone checker replays the finite integer certificate and rational moments.
